note: ⭐ VWAP's FIRST `expected` COLUMN IN THE PYTHON LANE. The two older vwap cases carry `expected: null` because Python had no VWAP when they were written; they are NOT reseeded (their whole value is that they never were), so this is a NEW case on the chart parity gate's own bars via `barsFrom`. It pins the CORRECTED session anchoring — `VWAP_SESSION_ANCHOR`, accepted 2026-08-03 — on the exact 579 five-minute extended-hours bars the chart renders, spanning a DST change. Measured on these bars, the retired UTC-day bucketing differs by up to $14.45 and stays more than $0.50 wrong for 134 positions, so a lane that ported the OLD logic cannot pass this at 1e-9.
